serviceStartDate.description: Service period start; required for add by this contract.

productRatePlanChargeId.description: Catalog charge ID for add only; overrides catalog-derived charge fields.

items.description: One explicit invoice item action.

dueDate.description: New payment due date; mutually exclusive with invoiceDate.

templateId.description: Invoice template ID; requires Flexible Billing Attributes.

invoiceDate.description: New invoice date in an open accounting period; mutually exclusive with dueDate.

changes.description: Partial invoice changes, not a full replacement.

functions.name: update-payment
functions.description: Partially modify payment comments, external transaction reference, reconciliation state, accounting fields or payment-schedule linkage.

comment.description: Replacement payment comment; empty string clears the comment.

referenceId.description: Replacement gateway transaction reference for External payments only; empty string clears it.

gatewayState.description: Gateway reconciliation state; requires Edit Payment Gateway Status permission.

financeInformation.description: Partial accounting changes, unavailable for standalone payments.

bankAccountAccountingCode.description: Bank account accounting code; empty string clears it.

unappliedPaymentAccountingCode.description: Unapplied payment accounting code; empty string clears it.

paymentScheduleKey.description: Payment schedule ID or number to link; omission preserves linkage, clearing is not exposed.

changes.description: Partial changes; omission preserves a field, null is rejected, and empty supported text clears it.

paymentId.description: Payment ID or number to modify.

FunctionInput_zuora_updatepayment.description: Identify a payment and supply only the payment fields to modify.

comment.description: Resulting payment comment; preserves null or empty string.

referenceId.description: Resulting gateway reference; preserves null or empty string.

paymentScheduleKey.description: Resulting linked payment schedule key, if returned.

FunctionOutput_zuora_updatepayment.description: Provider-confirmed fields of the updated payment.

tags.instructions: Get the key with `list-payments` or inspect it with `get-payment`. Use `apply-payment` for allocations and `refund-payment` for returning money. Only external payments allow referenceId updates. Gateway-state updates require Edit Payment Gateway Status permission; standalone payments cannot update finance information. Omitted fields are unchanged.

functions.name: update-payment-method
functions.description: Partially update an electronic payment method's expiry, holder, mandate, gateway options, or retry settings, including associating an orphan with an account.

holder.description: Partial holder contact changes; not supported for reference-transaction methods. Empty text requests clearing where allowed.

city.description: Holder city; empty requests clearing if allowed.

state.description: Holder state/province; empty requests clearing if allowed.

country.description: Provider-supported country name/abbreviation; empty may be disallowed by the gateway.

postalCode.description: Postal or ZIP code; empty requests clearing if allowed.

addressLine1.description: First address line; empty requests clearing if allowed.

addressLine2.description: Second address line; empty requests clearing.

mandate.description: Partial mandate changes for card, card-reference, ACH or bank transfer types.

id.description: Mandate identifier; empty requests clearing if supported.

reason.description: Gateway mandate reason; empty requests clearing.

status.description: Gateway mandate status; empty requests clearing if supported.

accountId.description: Account ID to attach an orphan to; cannot transfer or detach an already associated method.

ipAddress.description: Customer IPv4/IPv6 for fraud/validation; unsupported for reference-transaction updates.

customFields.description: Partial case-sensitive custom-field values; null requests clearing if supported. Unsupported for reference transactions.

anyOf.description: Request clearing of the custom-field value if supported.

additionalProperties.description: Custom-field value; null requests clearing if supported.

securityCode.description: CVV/CVV2 for card validation; not stored or returned.

expirationYear.description: New four-digit card expiration year; CreditCard only.

gatewayOptions.description: Gateway-specific string option map for this update; empty sends no options, not a reset. Unsupported for reference transactions.

additionalProperties.description: Gateway-specific option value for this update.

expirationMonth.description: New card expiration month; CreditCard only.

paymentGatewayId.description: Gateway override for this update; not supported for CreditCardReferenceTransaction.

useDefaultRetryRule.description: True selects tenant retry rules; false selects custom method retry settings.

paymentRetryWindowHours.description: Custom retry interval in hours; null requests clearing of the stored custom value. Applies only with custom retry rules.

maxConsecutivePaymentFailures.description: Custom maximum failures; null requests clearing of the stored custom value. Applies only with custom retry rules.

changes.description: Partial field changes; omitted fields are preserved, null is supported only for custom retry values and custom fields.

FunctionInput_zuora_updatepaymentmethod.description: Identify an electronic payment method and supply only the fields to change.

id.description: ID of the method whose requested update succeeded; does not imply a payment was collected.

FunctionOutput_zuora_updatepaymentmethod.description: The payment method whose update Zuora confirmed.

tags.instructions: Get the method's type with `get-payment-method` first. Use `create-payment-method` for a new instrument. Account association only attaches an orphan; it cannot transfer or detach an associated method. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Supplying securityCode can trigger gateway validation; without it, card updates do not validate through the gateway. No default-method change is supported here.

functions.name: update-subscription
functions.description: Partially modify subscription terms and notes and apply dated rate-plan additions, removals, replacements or charge changes.

notes.description: Replacement notes; empty string clears them.

amendments.description: Dated changes to subscription plan instances; not independent per-item outcomes.

action.description: Add a catalog plan, remove an instance, replace an instance, or update instance charges.

subType.description: Replacement amendment classification; omit for provider grading-based classification.

ratePlanId.description: Existing subscription rate-plan instance ID; required except for add.

bookingDate.description: Amendment booking date; omission uses provider current date.

chargeChanges.description: Price or quantity edits for updateCharges, using subscription charge instance IDs.

price.description: Replacement price in transaction currency major units according to charge model.

quantity.description: Replacement charge quantity; explicit zero is retained.

ratePlanChargeId.description: Existing subscription rate plan charge ID.

items.description: Price or quantity modification for one subscription charge instance.

effectiveDate.description: Contract-effective calendar date for this amendment.

productRatePlanId.description: Catalog plan ID to add or use as replacement.

resetBillCycleDay.description: For replace, reset account bill cycle day to the effective date; omitted sends false.

specificUpdateDate.description: Update Product effective date when an earlier future-dated update already exists.

serviceActivationDate.description: Activation date; omitted follows provider contract-date defaults.

customerAcceptanceDate.description: Acceptance date; requires activation date when supplied.

items.description: One dated subscription rate-plan amendment.

bookingDate.description: Booking date for a terms-and-conditions amendment; omitted uses provider current date.

currentTerm.description: Current term length; required when explicitly setting termType to TERMED.

renewalTerm.description: New renewal term length, including explicit zero.

renewalSetting.description: How a termed subscription transitions at renewal.

currentTermUnit.description: Calendar unit for currentTerm; omit to preserve existing unit.

renewalTermUnit.description: Calendar unit for renewalTerm; omitted preserves existing unit.

invoiceSeparately.description: Whether this subscription is billed separately, when enabled.

changes.description: Partial subscription modifications; absent values remain unchanged, null is rejected.

collect.description: Collect payment when runBilling=true; default false.

runBilling.description: Generate billing documents for this update; default false.

targetDate.description: Calculate billing charges through this date; omitted uses provider current date.

documentDate.description: Billing document calendar date; omitted uses targetDate.

subscriptionId.description: Subscription number or latest-version ID; prefer number because version IDs can change.

FunctionInput_zuora_updatesubscription.description: Partially update subscription terms, notes, and dated rate-plan amendments with optional billing and collection.

id.description: Resulting new subscription version ID, when returned.

invoiceId.description: Generated invoice ID; omitted if none.

paymentId.description: Collected payment ID; omitted if none.

paidAmount.description: Collected amount in transaction currency major units.

creditMemoId.description: Generated credit memo ID; omitted if none.

totalDeltaMrr.description: Change in subscription monthly recurring revenue.

totalDeltaTcv.description: Change in subscription total contracted value.

FunctionOutput_zuora_updatesubscription.description: Resulting subscription version and optional aggregate billing, collection, and revenue effects.

tags.instructions: Use `get-subscription` to obtain the latest subscription and its rate-plan/charge instance IDs. Prefer the subscription number for stable lookup. Use `preview-subscription-update` to estimate changes first. At most nine plan amendments per call. Omitted fields stay unchanged; notes='' clears notes. Use lifecycle tools for cancel, renew, suspend or resume.

functions.name: update-usage-record
functions.description: Partially modify usage quantity, unit, interval, custom fields or rating-engine status. Dynamic-pricing usage records are not supported by this legacy update.

endedAt.description: Replacement reporting end instant with explicit offset, at most milliseconds.

quantity.description: Replacement consumed units; must be losslessly representable by provider Quantity.

startedAt.description: Replacement usage start instant with explicit offset, at most milliseconds; affects rating.

customFields.description: Partial configured custom-field changes; omitted keys unchanged and null clears only where supported.

additionalProperties.description: Configured custom-field value; null requests supported clearing.

ratingStatus.description: Administrative rating/billing-engine status correction; provider may restrict writable transitions.

unitOfMeasure.description: Replacement unit configured in Billing Settings.

changes.description: Partial modifications; omitted properties unchanged, null rejected except supported custom-field clearing.

FunctionInput_zuora_updateusagerecord.description: Identify a usage record and supply only the fields to change.

id.description: Usage record ID confirmed by the update; not a rating completion guarantee.

FunctionOutput_zuora_updateusagerecord.description: The usage record identifier confirmed by a successful update.

Zuora-Entity-Ids.description: Optional entity context for a token authorized for multiple entities.

Zuora-Org-Ids.description: Optional comma-separated organization context for Multi-Org.

tags.instructions: Use a record ID and inspect it with `get-usage-record` first. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Start time affects rating; end time is reporting-only.
